title: Sliding receive, inertial staging and moving hand-off
summary: At the start a small cube slides along a raised, slippery lane toward its open end. Receive it in the shallow tray the Panda holds (open on one side) once it has left the lane and let it settle; then, keeping the tray level, make the cube slide inside the tray by moving the tray (tilting is not allowed) until it rests at a staging point; carry it through two waypoints; bring the tray to a pose at a fixed offset from a platform that slides slowly back and forth on a rail while matching its velocity; finally get the cube onto that platform, where it must ride along at rest without touching the tray.
robot_setup: One Panda, base at (-0.55, 0, 0), yaw 0 (facing +x). Its hand carries a blue shallow square tray: floor 5 mm thick, inner 0.18 m x 0.18 m (2 x `tool_half`, `tool_half` = 0.09 m), walls 0.03 m high and 5 mm thick on its +x, +y and -y sides, open (no wall) on its -x side. The tool frame is the centre of the tray floor's top surface, z up, x and y along the walls. The tray hangs from a rigid side adapter (part of the tool): from the hand a horizontal bar at tool z = 0.035 runs from tool x = -0.12 to 0 at tool y = +0.12, then along y to y = 0.09, then a short 12 mm post goes down onto the middle of the +y wall (rising 6 mm above the wall and protruding 6 mm into the tray). The Panda TCP is at (-0.12, 0.12, 0.04) in the tool frame, so with the tray level the gripper points straight down, outside the tray beyond its -x/+y corner. At the start the tray is level (tool axes aligned with the world axes), its frame origin at (0.21, -0.18, 0.13).
scene: A raised orange lane (a slab 0.36 m long along x, 0.11 m wide, on two posts) ends in the open toward +x. An orange cube (36 mm edge) slides along it toward that open end from t = 0; the lane and cube are slippery, so it leaves the lane end within the first second. A blue flat platform (0.28 m along x by 0.18 m, the receiver) rides on a straight rail along the world x axis and moves slowly back and forth along it for the whole episode, slowing to a stop at each end of its stroke. The tray's own surface is slippery too. The table top is the world's z = 0 plane.
scene_privileged: Lane: static box of half-extents (0.18, 0.055, 0.012) m centred at (-0.078, 0, 0.123) (top at z = 0.135, x -0.258..0.102, y -0.055..0.055), friction 0.015, two support posts. Cube ('block'): half-extent 0.018 m, mass `object_mass` = 0.035 kg, friction `friction` = 0.05, restitution 0.05. At t = 0 it is at (-0.17, y0, 0.1535), no rotation, with velocity (`incoming_speed`, 0, 0) = (0.58, 0, 0) m/s. Receiver: prismatic fixture with rail centre (`receiver_base_x`, 0.26, 0.13) = (-0.30, 0.26, 0.13), axis +x, limits +-0.5 m, moving link mass 0.3 kg; the platform is 0.28 x 0.18 x 0.02 m with its top surface centre at the link origin (z = 0.13). Drive law (oscillating): target q(t) = q0 + 0.20 sin((`fixture_speed`/0.20) t) = q0 + 0.20 sin(0.2 t) m, velocity target `fixture_speed` cos(0.2 t) (peak `fixture_speed` = 0.04 m/s), PD stiffness 80 N/m, damping 8 N s/m, force limit 8 N; at reset q = q0 and velocity = `fixture_speed`; period 31.4 s (moving +x until about 7.85 s, then -x until about 23.6 s). Random draws at reset, in this order: y0 ~ U(-0.01, 0.01) m, q0 ~ U(-0.02, 0.02) m. Tray: `tool_mass` = 0.2 kg, `tool_friction` = 0.05, restitution 0.05. Table friction `table_friction` = 0.08. Staging point flag `staging` = (`target_offset`, 0, 0.018) in the tray frame (not in the observation); `target_tolerance` = 0.014 m.

phases.name: source_to_tray
phases.text: the cube (which has touched the lane, as it starts on it) is supported by the tray (touched it within the last 25 ms), does not touch the lane, has its centre at world x > 0.12 m, and moves at less than 0.05 m/s relative to the tray, for 0.10 s without interruption. The cube's position in the tray frame at that moment is recorded as its received position.

phases.name: inertial_staging
phases.text: the tray must stay level throughout this phase: tilting its z axis more than 2.1 deg from world vertical fails the task (tilt_only_shortcut). (a) At some physics step of this phase the horizontal (world x-y) acceleration of the Panda TCP, taken as the 1 ms difference of its velocity, must exceed 1.1 x `friction` x g = 0.540 m/s^2; (b) at or after that step the cube's tray-frame x-y position must be more than 0.025 m away from its received position. After both, the cube must rest at the staging point: supported by the tray, its tray-frame x-y within `target_tolerance` = 0.014 m of (`target_offset`, 0) = (0.03, 0) m, moving at less than 0.045 m/s relative to the tray, for 0.3 s without interruption.

phases.name: transport_turn
phases.text: with the cube supported by the tray, the tray's frame origin comes within 0.022 m of waypoint A = (0.08, 0.13, 0.22), then within 0.022 m of waypoint B = (0.19, 0.20, 0.22), in this order.

phases.name: match_receiver
phases.text: at one physics step, all of: the cube is supported by the tray; the tray body's linear velocity differs from the platform's by less than 0.05 m/s; and the tray's frame origin is within 0.012 m of the point offset (0.34, 0, 0.008) m, in world axes, from the centre of the platform's top surface (0.34 m in +x and 8 mm above it).

phases.name: support_transfer
phases.text: the cube touches the platform, is not supported by the tray (no cube-tray contact within the last 25 ms), its centre is within 0.07 m of the platform's centre along both world x and world y, and its velocity differs from the platform's by less than 0.045 m/s, for 0.5 s without interruption. This completes the task.

task_failures: tilt_only_shortcut: during inertial_staging, the tray's z axis tilts more than 2.1 deg from world vertical.

spill: during inertial_staging, transport_turn or match_receiver, the cube's centre in the tray frame is more than 0.015 m below the tray floor's top surface, or more than `tool_half` + 0.02 = 0.11 m from the tray centre along tray x or y.
contact_rules: Only the tray (including its adapter) may touch anything, and it may touch only the cube: touching the lane, the platform or its rail, or the table is forbidden. No other part of the robot, the fingers included, may touch anything, the cube included.
world_goals_fixed: Receive line: cube centre at world x > 0.12 m (source_to_tray). Staging point in the tray frame: (0.03, 0) m, tolerance 0.014 m. Waypoint A (0.08, 0.13, 0.22) and waypoint B (0.19, 0.20, 0.22) for the tray's frame origin, tolerance 0.022 m (announced as `goal_waypoints`). Match pose: platform top-surface centre + (0.34, 0, 0.008) m, tolerance 0.012 m.
difficulty_note: The cube arrives fast, so the tray has to be in place within a fraction of a second; the staging slide on a slippery tray must be produced by the tray's own horizontal motion while it stays within 2.1 deg of level, and the final hand-off is to a platform that never stops moving for long.
standard_notes: The cube is already sliding along the lane at t = 0 and drops off its open end within the first second. The platform moves back and forth for the whole episode, slowing to a stop at the ends of its stroke.
